spec: D619; SETTLEMENT_FLOW_LEDGER_PREREG.md section 3.1 line 67 (the panel schema)

column_units.nav: USD per share, as published (the series is back-adjusted for reverse splits)
column_units.shares_out: SHARES. The source column is 'Shares Outstanding (000)', published to two decimals of thousands; multiplied by 1000 here, so every value is an exact multiple of 10 shares and that 10 is the rounding unit.
column_units.source: the URL the row's CSV was fetched from
column_units.fetched_at: the recorder's fetched_at for that CSV -- the availability time (deposit decision D23); this source states no published_at

deposit_columns_absent.why: ProShares' historical NAV CSV carries none of them. They are ABSENT rather than null-filled: a column of nulls reads as data missing on those days, an absent column says the source never had it. Holdings (the futures/swap split by contract month) are FORWARD ONLY from this issuer -- see D619 and scripts/fetch_fund_holdings.py; the free historical route is the Schedule of Investments in the quarterly 10-Q and annual 10-K, at a 40-90 day lag.

seed_row_rule.why: the published share count rounds to zero beside a multi-million-dollar AUM, so no per-share or creation-flow arithmetic is possible on those rows. NOTHING IS RESCALED; the rows are dropped and named.
seed_row_rule.rejected_alternative: nav > 1e4 -- refused by the data: 2,327 of BOIL's rows and 7 of SCO's carry NAV above 10,000 and are ordinary rows of a back-adjusted series.

splits.detector: a NAV discontinuity of more than 15% against the series' own Prior NAV column, with the shares_out jump beside it
splits.why_empty: the published series is FULLY BACK-ADJUSTED for reverse splits, so it carries no discontinuity to find: NAV[t]/PriorNAV[t] equals 1 + the stated NAV Change (%) on every row, and the carry deviation is at most 1.5e-2. BOIL's first row implies 0.50005 shares outstanding, which is the adjustment showing itself.
splits.no_independent_source: No split source other than the series itself was available. data/raw/alphavantage/daily_adjusted_etf/ holds UNG and USO only -- neither is one of these four -- and carries prices, not corporate actions.

gate_definitions.G1_aum_identity: |nav*shares_out - aum| <= |nav|*(10.0/2 + 1e-3) on >= 0.99 of rows per fund. The naive 1 bp share is REPORTED beside it and is not the bar: the source rounds shares to 10, which the early low-share era cannot carry.
gate_definitions.G2_dates_increasing: dates strictly increase within each fund
gate_definitions.G4_four_funds: exactly BOIL, KOLD, SCO, UCO, each non-empty
gate_definitions.G5_spans: each fund's first and last date, reported

encoding: utf-8, LF, deterministic gzip (mtime=0, no stored filename), so the digest is a fact about the rows and not about when the build ran
holdout: NAV, SHARES AND AUM ONLY -- no return, no signal, no trade. The series spans 2008-11-24..2026-09-18, which runs through the deposit's sealed vault window (2025-03-01..2026-09-18) and past this repository's 2024-01-01 holdout, neither of which the principal has reconciled with the other. Nothing here may score anything until that reconciliation is in writing (D604, D619).
